title: Is Grammarly Worth It in 2026? Pricing & Business Verdict

facts.fact: Grammarly's Pro plan replaced the old Premium and Business plans and works for individuals and teams of up to 149 seats.
facts.quote: Pro replaced both the old Premium and Business plans and works for individuals and teams up to 149 seats.

facts.fact: Per the page, Grammarly's own pricing page lists Pro at around $12 per member per month when billed annually.
facts.quote: Pro costs around $12 per member per month billed annually, or about $30 per month billed monthly, per Grammarly's own pricing page.

facts.fact: Per the page, Grammarly's own pricing page lists Pro at about $30 per month when billed monthly.
facts.quote: Pro costs around $12 per member per month billed annually, or about $30 per month billed monthly, per Grammarly's own pricing page.

facts.fact: The page states that paying month to month roughly doubles the cost per seat compared with the annual headline rate.
facts.unit: x multiple of annual per-seat cost
facts.quote: Paying month to month roughly doubles the cost per seat.

facts.fact: The Free plan costs $0 and includes around 100 AI prompts per month, according to the page.
facts.quote: Free — $0. Basic grammar, spelling, tone signals, and around 100 AI prompts per month.

facts.fact: The page says the Pro plan includes about 2,000 AI prompts per member per month.
facts.unit: AI prompts per member per month
facts.quote: ~2,000 AI prompts/member/month, 1 style guide, 1 brand tone, and team analytics.

facts.fact: The page says the Pro plan includes one style guide and one brand tone, and Enterprise is needed for unlimited guides and tones.
facts.quote: Pro includes 1 style guide and 1 brand tone.

facts.fact: The page says Enterprise pricing is a custom quote rather than a published list price.
According to the page, Grammarly can issue invoices payable by ACH, wire, or card for annual Pro with 10 or more members.
facts.quote: Grammarly reports for annual Pro with 10+ members it can issue invoices payable by ACH, wire, or card

facts.fact: The page says Enterprise adds SAML SSO, SCIM, admin controls, data-loss prevention, audit logs, BYOK encryption, and unlimited style guides and brand tones.
facts.quote: Adds SAML SSO, SCIM, admin controls, data-loss prevention, audit logs, BYOK encryption, and unlimited style guides and brand tones.
